outOfScope: Changing product WHAT or acceptance semantics to make an efficiency candidate pass.
Replacing Application domain authority, Oracle source ownership, Jev/QA judgment authority or EffectOperation truth.
Adopting Unreal Agent wholesale or treating its benchmark as ExHarness acceptance evidence.
constraints: At most one model generation is active per coordinator session. New steering may cancel/fence a generation, but may not create overlapping authoritative model responses.
Every user/control input and detached-operation transition is durably accepted before it can influence scheduling; a process crash cannot erase an acknowledged input or terminal transition.
Canonical event order is the monotonically increasing durable ingress sequence. Scheduling priority may change when the next model turn starts, but may not reorder committed input/history semantics.
Completion coalescing must be bounded and deterministic, and user steering/stop bypasses any completion grace or idle window.
User steering cancels/fences model generation only; it does not cancel detached operations unless an explicit stop/cancel control is durably accepted.
Stop/cancel authority is a durable fence. Local AbortSignal delivery is a transport hint and cannot relabel an unresolved external effect as cancelled.
Recovery derives pending work from exact BB-078 detached-operation/effect truth plus BB-079 async-context checkpoints, never from traces, prompt prose or provider cache state.
Research may run ahead of BB-078/079 delivery. Worker start must resolve exact DONE dependency artifacts; incompatible delivered contracts are PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Efficiency observations in BB-080 are development evidence only. BB-081 owns held-out matched acceptance and PROMOTE_ASYNC/KEEP_SYNC.
invariants: Async scheduling and prompt optimization cannot become correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
Every detached operation remains bound to exact call/turn/action/effect identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed.
Efficiency claims require matched evidence with fixed model, task semantics, tool surface and resource budget.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Add a scoped Core `createAsyncAgentCoordinator()` outside AgentRuntime. It owns durable ingress/wake/model-generation coordination only and composes the delivered BB-078 detached-operation manager plus BB-079 async-result projector; it does not become effect, acceptance or product authority.

D2 — Persist one coordinator document per explicit session scope through the existing revision-aware SessionStore CAS contract. The document contains revision, nextIngressSeq, accepted ingress envelopes, dedupe bindings, wake state, modelGeneration, currentSubmission, stopFence, async-result checkpoint reference/snapshot and last committed model-turn identity.

D3 — Every accepted event becomes an immutable `ASYNC_AGENT_INGRESS/v1` envelope with monotonic `ingressSeq`, deterministic/deduplicable source identity and one kind: USER_INPUT, STOP, OPERATION_TRANSITION or EXPLICIT_WAKE. BB-078 transitionId is the dedupe key for operation updates; caller-supplied inputId is required for retry-safe user/control ingestion.

D4 — Enqueue, dedupe/coalesce decision and one-active-wake claim occur inside the same CAS revision domain. Never decide 'no active wake' from an unlocked snapshot and insert later. This explicitly avoids the wake-coalescing TOCTOU failure documented in Paperclip issue #10598.

D5 — Persisted ingressSeq defines semantic order. STOP and USER_INPUT have scheduling priority over completion-only wakes, but the coordinator never reorders their durable envelopes relative to already accepted input. USER_INPUT and STOP bypass completion coalescing immediately.

D6 — Preserve the existing one-model-in-flight invariant with a durable `modelGeneration` fencing token. Each submitted model request binds `submissionId`, modelGeneration and the exact accepted-ingress/high-water mark it covers. Only the current generation may persist/dispatch its response.

D7 — Add an explicit model-generation cancellation capability: `ABORT_SIGNAL` or safe-default `FENCE_ONLY`. AgentRuntime/strategy passes an AbortSignal to model.generate when the selected adapter declares ABORT_SIGNAL; FENCE_ONLY adapters may ignore cancellation, but any late response from a fenced generation is discarded before action normalization, tool dispatch or result publication.

D8 — User steering path is persist-first: CAS-accept USER_INPUT, cancel any completion grace, fence/increment modelGeneration, signal AbortController when supported, then schedule exactly one replacement model turn. Detached operations continue unless the user separately issues STOP/cancel.

D9 — STOP path is persist-first and stronger: CAS the stopFence before aborting the model or requesting BB-078 cancellations. After the fence, no new model/tool dispatch or detached-operation launch/retry may begin. Recovery re-applies the same fence until every in-flight operation is terminal/reconcilable.

D10 — Operation completions never preempt an active model generation. While a model is active, BB-078 transitions are durably accepted and staged through BB-079 for the next turn. When idle, the coordinator drains a deterministic completion burst until `completionIdleMs` expires or `maxCoalescedTransitions` is reached, then creates one wake. Default research profile: 1 ms idle drain and max 100 transitions, matching Unreal Agent's bounded slurp pattern; both values are explicit/injected for deterministic tests.

D11 — After dispatching detached operations, an optional `quickCompletionGraceMs` delays only a completion-only follow-up wake so fast operations may finish together. Default research profile: 1000 ms, matching Unreal Agent's tool-call grace. USER_INPUT or STOP cancels this grace immediately, so interactive steering is never delayed by it.

D12 — Do not add autonomous model heartbeats. A model turn requires semantic work: accepted USER_INPUT, unseen operation transition/result, explicit caller wake or restart reconstruction that proves pending work. Liveness timers may inspect state but cannot call the model solely because time elapsed.

D13 — Recovery loads the durable coordinator first, re-establishes the stop fence, asks delivered BB-078 recovery to reconcile every nonterminal operation, then stages unseen BB-078 transitions through delivered BB-079 state. A model request recorded in-flight at crash is marked ABANDONED, modelGeneration advances, and at most one replacement wake is scheduled from durable pending ingress/context.

D14 — Scheduled-before-dispatch and dispatched-before-terminal are not coordinator guesses. BB-078 owns both cases: absent/INTENDED work may execute exact same semantic effect identity under its replay policy; DISPATCHED/UNKNOWN goes through effect reconciliation. The coordinator only decides whether new model work is needed after that truth converges.

D15 — `createResumableAgentRuntime().snapshot()` remains an idle runtime snapshot and is not repurposed as in-flight coordinator durability because current Core explicitly rejects snapshot while activeCalls > 0. Coordinator state is persisted separately and can reference an idle runtime snapshot when available.

D16 — Reuse BB-077's exact development benchmark/accounting contract for BB-080 probes. Record steering-to-next-turn latency, coalesced transition count, model-generation abort/fence outcomes, replacement turns, restart recovery turns, duplicate effects and unknown provider usage; do not open HOLD-* tasks or make the BB-081 promotion decision.

D17 — Public implementations are pattern evidence only: Unreal Agent demonstrates one loop, bounded slurp, generation cancellation and a quick tool-call grace; Paperclip specifies DB-backed coalesced wakeups and also documents a real TOCTOU failure when coalescing happens before locking; Restate demonstrates durable single-writer keyed state and durable wait/signal/recovery patterns. None becomes a runtime dependency or proves ExHarness efficiency.

expectedDependencyOutputs: BB-077 DONE: exact development benchmark/accounting registry and control profile.
BB-078 DONE: exact detached-operation store/transition/recovery/cancel API.
BB-079 DONE: exact append-only async-result context checkpoint and provider async-delivery capability API.

implementationSlices: S1 — At worker start resolve exact DONE BB-077/078/079 implementation-result, judgment and Living refs. Bind the coordinator implementation to their delivered benchmark/transition/context contracts; any incompatible field/identity/capability shape stops as PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

S2 — Implement `async-agent-coordinator.js` with revision-aware SessionStore state, immutable ingress envelopes, input/transition dedupe, monotonic ingressSeq, modelGeneration/submission fencing, durable stopFence and one-active-wake CAS. Prove concurrent enqueue/coalesce decisions cannot create two current wakes.

S3 — Add model cancellation plumbing for the JavaScript CodeAct async profile: normalize `generationCancellation` capability, preserve it through model routing, propagate run AbortSignal through AgentRuntime, pass it to model.generate for ABORT_SIGNAL routes and fence every response before action/tool dispatch. Legacy adapters default to FENCE_ONLY and remain compatible.

S4 — Implement persist-first USER_INPUT and STOP handling plus bounded operation-completion drain/quick-completion grace with injected clock/timers. Steering bypasses both windows; operation completion does not abort a model in flight; STOP prevents all later dispatch/retry starts.

S5 — Implement restore: reload coordinator, reapply stopFence, invoke delivered BB-078 recovery, stage unseen transitions through delivered BB-079, abandon/fence any crash-time model submission and schedule at most one replacement wake. Do not use active resumable-runtime snapshot as the source of pending async work.

S6 — Add deterministic race/restart tests: simultaneous wakeups, steering during model generation, non-abortable late model response, stop during dispatch, scheduled-before-dispatch crash, dispatched-before-terminal crash, duplicate transition delivery and process restart during completion grace.

S7 — Run BB-077 DEV-only matched probes for synchronous vs BB-080 async coordination and record model turns, steering latency, coalescing, recovery, failures/retries, token/cost/cache fields when available and duplicate-effect count. No HOLD-* execution and no PROMOTE_ASYNC/KEEP_SYNC conclusion.

S8 — Export only the scoped coordinator/capability surface and update Core Living Docs with the one-model invariant, event order, persistence/recovery boundary, cancellation fallback and known provider limitations.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A retry-safe USER_INPUT accepted while a detached operation and/or model generation is active is durably ordered immediately, bypasses completion coalescing, fences the old model generation and causes exactly one bounded replacement turn without waiting for unrelated operations.
evidenceRequired: Injected slow-operation/slow-model fixture showing durable inputId+ingressSeq, old generation fenced/aborted, replacement submission high-water mark includes the input, and unrelated operation remains RUNNING.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A provider that ignores cancellation cannot make a fenced model response authoritative: the late response is rejected before action normalization, capability dispatch or result publication.
evidenceRequired: FENCE_ONLY model fixture returning after steering, with zero action/tool dispatch from the stale submission and exactly one accepted successor generation.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Concurrent/near-simultaneous operation transitions are durably deduped and coalesced into at most one current completion wake/model turn per drained burst, while semantic order remains ingressSeq and concurrent enqueue cannot create two active wakes.
evidenceRequired: Concurrent Promise.all ingress fixture, duplicate transitionId fixture, injected 1ms/100-item drain boundary, and one-wake assertion under CAS conflicts.

evidenceRequired: Stop-during-model and stop-during-effect fixtures, crash after fence before abort, restart proof, and NON_RECONCILABLE/UNKNOWN negative case.

negativeVerificationCases: Two concurrent completion/user wake requests both read no active wake before locking and create two current model runs.
USER_INPUT waits behind a completion coalescing/grace timer.
USER_INPUT implicitly cancels unrelated detached operations.
A late response from a fenced/non-abortable model generation dispatches a capability or terminal result.
STOP is delivered to AbortController before the durable stopFence commits and a crash permits new dispatch after restart.
A detached operation causes a duplicate non-idempotent external effect after scheduled-before-dispatch or dispatched-before-terminal recovery.
A duplicate BB-078 transitionId becomes two BB-079 context items or two model wakes.
An idle liveness timer creates model calls without new semantic work.
An active createResumableAgentRuntime snapshot is treated as durable in-flight operation truth despite RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_CALL.
A DEV cost/token/turn win is used to label PROMOTE_ASYNC or HOLD-* tasks are executed before BB-081.

coordinatorContract.ordering: ingressSeq is the semantic total order within one coordinator session; scheduling priority cannot rewrite it.
coordinatorContract.oneActiveModel: Every request binds submissionId + modelGeneration + coveredIngressSeq. Only current generation may dispatch/publish.
coordinatorContract.oneActiveWake: Wake/coalesce claim is decided in the same revision-aware CAS transaction/update as accepted ingress.
coordinatorContract.persistenceBoundary: Dedicated coordinator state through existing revision-aware SessionStore. Runtime snapshots remain idle snapshots only.

rules: While model is active, operation transitions are persisted/staged but do not preempt the current generation.
When idle, completion-only work drains until completionIdleMs of quiet or maxCoalescedTransitions.
A quick-completion grace may delay only a completion-only follow-up after detached dispatch.
USER_INPUT and STOP cancel/bypass all completion windows immediately.
No autonomous model heartbeat exists in the default profile.

modes.ABORT_SIGNAL: Adapter/provider route declares cooperative cancellation; pass AbortSignal and still enforce generation fencing.
modes.FENCE_ONLY: Safe default. Abort may be unavailable/ignored; late response is discarded before action/tool/result authority.
